  • Constructor Details

    • Dinosaur

      public Dinosaur(String name, String timePeriod, String diet, String clade, String fossilLocation, double size)
      Creates a dinosaur using the six required attributes
      Parameters:
      name - the dinosaur's unique name
      timePeriod - the geological time period
      diet - the dinosaur's diet
      clade - the dinosaur's clade
      fossilLocation - the fossil discovery location
      size - the dinosaur's size
